title.narrative: Multilateral M&D and NSD Support to MRCS via IFRC

description.narrative:
As of April 2024, Moldova had recorded a total of 1 million arrivals from Ukraine. Notably, it hosts 118,249 individual refugees, the most on the continent considering per-capita populations, with a striking 84% comprising women and children. As the emergency evolves into a more protracted stage, those who remain in Moldova are facing challenges extending beyond immediate basic needs to encompass socio-economic integration and comprehensive protection.
Through BRC's scoping visit in August 2023 and various partnership meetings, a comprehensive approach to supporting MRCS and vulnerable populations is recognized as crucial. This is a multi-year multilateral partnership with IFRC (and in turn the Moldova Red Cross Society, MRCS) to support people displaced by the Ukraine Crisis in Moldova and other vulnerable groups of people on the move as well as the local population in Moldova, who have also been significantly impacted by the Ukraine crisis. This grant also aims to support MRCS’ National Society Development objectives, to build MRCS capacity and increase the relevance and quality of humanitarian assistance provided by MRCS to affected populations.
